categories.label: Agents and profiles

categories.description: Portable non-secret runtime settings and preferences.

categories.label: Model connections
categories.description: Connection metadata and encrypted provider credentials.

categories.label: UI authentication
categories.description: UI auth configuration and OIDC credentials. Basic passwords are nonportable and require deliberate reconfiguration.
